description: The live health board, not a list to choose from: is public DNS OK right now? Every public resolver isitdns watches, its verdict from every isitdns seat that voted this round (ok, slow, partial, bad, no data), its latency from one seat (the board's first seat, named in the median line, or another network, named on the row, when that seat did not vote), DNSSEC, and the time it was read. The text is the 30 s board text and the JSON is /api/status (60 s), so the two can be from readings up to a minute apart; in that JSON each resolver row has a status field that is still the board round's reading, and the votes are in its global field, each vote under its seat's name. Give a resolver to get one card.

resolver.description: One resolver by id (cloudflare, google, quad9, opendns, adguard, cleanbrowsing, controld, quad9-unfiltered, adguard-family, cleanbrowsing-family, adguard-unfiltered, opendns-familyshield, nextdns, cloudflare-malware, cloudflare-family, mullvad-base, dns4eu-protective), alias or address; omit for the whole board
